data.name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Mexicali
data.address: Calzada Lic, Manuel Gómez Morín 855-Interior Col, Rivera, 21259 Mexicali, B.C., Mexico
data.description:
Set 7 km from the Calexico East Port of Entry, this contemporary budget hotel in a commercial area is also 12 km from the Calexico Gran Plaza Outlets and 16 km from Aeropuerto Internacional General Rodolfo Sánchez Taboada.
The unfussy rooms come with free Wi-Fi, safes and flat-screen TVs, as well as tea and coffeemakers. Suites add minifridges, microwaves, and sitting areas with pull-out sofas.
Parking is complimentary, as is a hot breakfast buffet served in a colorful dining area. There’s also an exercise room, a guest laundry and an outdoor pool.
